tasks.subject: Task 1: Parse hydrus:// references from note text
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Pure `parseHydrusRefs(noteBody)` -> `{label,hash}[]`, deduped by hash.

**Files:** Create `src/hydrus/noteRefs.ts`; Test `src/__tests__/note-refs.test.ts`.

**Verify:** `make test -- note-refs`

```json:metadata
{"files": ["src/hydrus/noteRefs.ts", "src/__tests__/note-refs.test.ts"], "verifyCommand": "make test -- note-refs", "acceptanceCriteria": ["extracts label+hash", "ordered multiples", "dedupe by hash", "case-insensitive hex, ignores malformed", "ignores plain/wiki/bare links"], "requiresUserVerification": false}
```

tasks.subject: Task 2: Resolve references and download to cache
tasks.description:
**Goal:** `resolveHydrusRefs` (cache-first + single remote batch) and `ensureLocalCopy`. Relocate `mediaTypeOf` to `client.ts`.

**Files:** Modify `src/hydrus/client.ts`, `src/views/HydrusExplorerModal.ts`, `src/hydrus/noteRefs.ts`; Test `src/__tests__/note-refs.test.ts`.

**Verify:** `make test -- note-refs && make typecheck`

```json:metadata
{"files": ["src/hydrus/noteRefs.ts", "src/hydrus/client.ts", "src/views/HydrusExplorerModal.ts", "src/__tests__/note-refs.test.ts"], "verifyCommand": "make test -- note-refs && make typecheck", "acceptanceCriteria": ["cache-first offline resolve", "single batch remote resolve", "unavailable when uncached+null client", "network error => unavailable", "ensureLocalCopy hit/miss/throw", "mediaTypeOf shared from client.ts"], "requiresUserVerification": false}
```

tasks.subject: Task 3: Copy image/video reference in tile menu
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Tile menu action copying `[<label>](hydrus://<hash>)`, titled per media type.

**Files:** Modify `src/views/HydrusExplorerModal.ts`, `.agent/features/hydrus-integration/explorer.md`.

**Verify:** `make build`

```json:metadata
{"files": ["src/views/HydrusExplorerModal.ts", ".agent/features/hydrus-integration/explorer.md"], "verifyCommand": "make build", "acceptanceCriteria": ["title varies by media type", "copies markdown link + Notice", "explorer.md updated"], "requiresUserVerification": false}
```

tasks.subject: Task 4: Merge note refs into Add Image and Add BG
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Both pickers list resolved Hydrus refs; selecting downloads + adds layer/background. New spec + cross-spec updates.

**Files:** Modify `src/views/DmControlPanel.ts`, `src/views/HydrusExplorerModal.ts`; Create `.agent/features/hydrus-integration/note-references.md`; Modify `.agent/features/hydrus-integration/overview.md`, `image-layers/overview.md`, `background-media/overview.md`.

**Verify:** `make typecheck && make test && make build`

```json:metadata
{"files": ["src/views/DmControlPanel.ts", "src/views/HydrusExplorerModal.ts", ".agent/features/hydrus-integration/note-references.md", ".agent/features/hydrus-integration/overview.md", ".agent/features/image-layers/overview.md", ".agent/features/background-media/overview.md"], "verifyCommand": "make typecheck && make test && make build", "acceptanceCriteria": ["Add Image merges image refs, hides videos, disables unavailable", "Add BG merges image+video refs", "Hydrus: <label> titles", "direct-apply rule", "layer via uniqueLayerLabel", "bg broadcast + markUsed", "offline cached still works", "specs created/updated"], "requiresUserVerification": false}
```

tasks.subject: Task 6: Cut beta and open PR (user verification)
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Publish `0.21.0-beta.1`, open PR with `release:minor`, user confirms the flow.

**Files:** `manifest.json`, `package.json`, `package-lock.json`.

**User Verification Required:** Call AskUserQuestion asking whether the beta flow works. If problems: fix, bump to beta.2, re-publish, re-verify.

**Verify:** `gh release view v0.21.0-beta.1`

```json:metadata

Funciona el flujo Copy reference -> nota -> Add Image/Add BG?"}
